title: Streaks: Daily Habit Tracker
shortDescription: Check off daily habits, see your streaks and add a photo to each habit.
fullDescription:
Streaks helps you build daily habits: check each one off once a day and watch the streak grow.

Add a habit, then tap its circle on the Today list when you have done it. Streaks counts the days in a row you kept it up. Miss a day and the streak starts again.

- Add habits by name from the Today list
- Check off today's habits and see how many are done
- See the current streak for every habit at a glance
- Open a habit to see its current streak, best streak and total check-ins
- Add a photo to a habit with the camera or from your photo library
- Delete a habit and its history when you no longer need it
- Light and dark mode

Your habits, check-ins and photos stay on your device. Streaks has no ads and no tracking, and you can delete your account and all of its data from Settings at any time.

Streaks is free, with no in-app purchases.

Questions or problems: https://github.com/NokNok-0/store-ready/issues
